scope: Five supplied Amazon links. Findings are limited to what the official pages and policy texts show on 2026-11-20. No conversion, revenue or demand estimates are made.

findings.finding: The five supplied links resolve to five different Amazon products in two categories: three air fryers and two thermometers.
findings.evidence: Each short link resolved to a different /dp/ ASIN (B0CDY277D3, B09B7SB46R, B08DKYBTPH, B0DHZTCNR5, B0DZFD6R9Z). Breadcrumbs show Air Fryers and Thermometers & Timers > Meat.

findings.finding: The intended ASIN cannot be read from the supplied links.
findings.evidence: Short-link codes are 9 characters. The resolved ASINs are 10 characters and differ from the codes.

findings.finding: No observed redirect target carries the Associates tag shown in the brief.
findings.evidence: None of the five resolved URLs contains tag=shopnow047c-20.
findings.confidence: Verified for the observed URLs. Attribution method not verified (FLG-02).

findings.finding: Price and rating fields cannot be published under the current data path.
findings.evidence: Program Policies §2(b) and §6(t) allow prices and ratings only when Amazon serves them or via PA-API / Creators API.

findings.finding: Price tracking is restricted, which conflicts with the 'analyzes pricing' goal.
The Associates identification statement is required and is shown on every page.
findings.evidence: Operating Agreement §5 requires the statement 'As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases' clearly and prominently.

findings.finding: Short-link compliance is unresolved and must be tested rather than assumed.
findings.evidence: Program Policies §6(w) on shortened links; the brief itself says the status is unresolved.

findings.finding: Publishing site-wide analytics or a click endpoint needs a hosting decision first.
findings.evidence: GitHub Pages publishes static files from a branch or /docs folder.

findings.finding: Sitemap and RSS are generated from the site's own data, so a new guide can be added by editing data.
findings.evidence: sitemaps.org requires loc with a trailing slash where the server requires it; RSS 2.0 requires channel title, link and description.
